title: frontier install lock
description: The installation's pinned record of how frontier was installed (spec #92, tickets #94 and #97). The file lives at <code>/.frontier/dist.lock.json. Every installation records its distribution, source, install time, requirements and skill pointer digest. A package install additionally records version, channel, artifact digest, package file count and manifest digest. A source install instead records the git commit and dirty state and records no package-only fields, so it never pretends to have a distribution version or artifact. Extra fields are allowed so later tickets can extend the record without rewriting this schema.

distribution.description: How frontier was installed. Package installs write 'package'; source checkouts write 'source' (#97).

version.description: Package installs: the version recorded by the package manifest. Source installs omit this field (the commit is the evidence instead).

channel.description: Package installs: the release channel recorded by the digest and package manifest. Source installs omit this field.

artifact_sha256.description: Package installs: SHA-256 of the downloaded zip artifact before extraction. Source installs omit this field.

source_url.description: Where the installation came from: the canonical file:// URL of the artifact (package) or the repository URL of the source checkout (source).

installed_at.description: ISO-8601 local time when this lock was written; preserved on an idempotent reinstall and on rollback.

requires.description: Package installs copy the manifest's compat object here. A source install records an empty object because there is no distribution manifest to require anything of the host.

skill_digest.description: SHA-256 of <code>/skills/frontier-run/SKILL.md that the registered pointer records; empty until install skill writes the pointer (#97).

package_file_count.description: Package installs: number of files listed by the package manifest (manifest.json itself is not counted). Source installs omit this field.

manifest_sha256.description: Package installs: SHA-256 of the extracted manifest.json bytes. Source installs omit this field.

commit.description: Source installs: the git commit the checkout was on when the installation was established. Package installs omit this field (their commit lives in the manifest as built_from_commit).

dirty.description: Source installs: whether the checkout had uncommitted changes at install time. Package installs omit this field.

previous_version.description: The retained previous version (ticket #96). Present after an upgrade that retained a release; after a rollback it names the version that was active before the rollback. Absent for a first install and for source installs.

rolled_back_at.description: ISO-8601 local time of the most recent rollback (ticket #96). Absent until a rollback happens; an upgrade writes a fresh lock without it.
